set -euo pipefail
require_one() {
  package="$1"
  test_name="$2"
  output="$(go test -list "^${test_name}$" "$package")"
  count="$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -c "^${test_name}$" || true)"
  if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'FAIL: expected exactly one %s in %s; found %s\n' "$test_name" "$package" "$count" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'PASS: %s in %s\n' "$test_name" "$package"
}

set -euo pipefail
require_pass() {
  package="$1"
  test_name="$2"
  output="$(mktemp)"
  trap 'rm -f "$output"' RETURN
  if ! go test -json -count=1 -run "^${test_name}$" "$package" >"$output"; then
    cat "$output" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  run_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"run".*"Test":"'"${test_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  pass_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"pass".*"Test":"'"${test_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  skip_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"skip".*"Test":"'"${test_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  fail_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"fail".*"Test":"'"${test_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  desc_skip_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"skip".*"Test":"'"${test_name}"'/[^\"]+"' "$output" || true)"
  desc_fail_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"fail".*"Test":"'"${test_name}"'/[^\"]+"' "$output" || true)"
  if [ "$run_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$pass_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$skip_count" -ne 0 ] || [ "$fail_count" -ne 0 ] || [ "$desc_skip_count" -gt 0 ] || [ "$desc_fail_count" -gt 0 ]; then
    cat "$output" >&2
    printf 'FAIL: %s in %s run=%s pass=%s skip=%s fail=%s desc_skip=%s desc_fail=%s\n' "$test_name" "$package" "$run_count" "$pass_count" "$skip_count" "$fail_count" "$desc_skip_count" "$desc_fail_count" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  printf 'PASS: %s in %s\n' "$test_name" "$package"
}
